mechanism: Deutetrabenazine inhibits CYP2D6 and may increase dronedarone levels; dronedarone prolongs QT interval and deutetrabenazine has potential arrhythmogenic effects, creating additive cardiac risk.
action: Monitor ECG and cardiac function closely; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if possible; assess dronedarone efficacy and toxicity; baseline and periodic QTc monitoring recommended.
